criteria.description: Confirmed authority covers the owner-scoped W1 projection seam and lifecycle compatibility work while excluding broad lint/compiler changes, released generations, publication, push, merge, release, and final-verdict actions.
criteria.limitations: The gate authorizes only the transient core lifecycle handoff, projection baseline enforcement, and their compatibility/documentation tests. It does not authorize a general asynchronous history API or a query-to-projection dependency.

criteria.description: The source-grounded design supplies constructor-owned events at session/created, keeps projection restore/hydrate as explicit supplied-cut paths, rejects silent late registration, and removes direct Session history reads from the registry without changing Session format or durable data.
criteria.limitations: A12 must not preserve an implicit history fallback when a baseline is missing, retain a registry-wide event backlog, or make a synchronous projection fold await storage.

criteria.description: Acceptance requires fresh, seeded, restored, forked, late-registration, HMR, checkpoint-cache, exact-watermark, missing-gap, event-payload, generated-documentation, type, lint, focused-test, dependency, and whitespace evidence, plus a complete-candidate metric check before any ratchet claim.
criteria.limitations: The gate authorizes implementation only; it is not implementation or candidate-qualification evidence.

conditions: Do not bump SESSION_FORMAT_VERSION or modify durable Session event envelopes, persistence schemas, projection wire values, or released generations.

Treat SessionCreationBaseline.events as borrowed lifecycle input: projection code must fold or detach required state before session/created delivery returns and must not expose the array as a new history reader.
Require a named failure for an eventful Session registered without a baseline; do not serve init-only or stale state.
Install projection cells before projection-cache creation checkpointing and preserve inheritedEventCount, firstLiveSeq, end-seed, disposal, and HMR behavior.
Update all typed session/created consumers and generated/event-producer documentation; run the focused checks and canonical metrics only on a complete successor candidate before promoting counts.

revalidation_triggers: The implementation changes Session format generations, persistence rows, wire payloads, or raw event sequence values.
A projection retains the borrowed baseline array, reads a shadowed persistence log, or falls back to init state for an eventful Session.
A late registration or HMR path returns state without proving an exact baseline and watermark.
Generated event-consumer documentation, focused lifecycle/projection tests, cancellation/teardown behavior, or package type/lint checks do not remain green.
